findings.description: GNU make exits 2 whenever a recipe fails. So a custom adapter whose test command is `make test` (built as `sh -c` in src/adapters/custom.adapter.ts L156-161) never gets a re-run for a real flake. It is also treated the same as pytest's interrupt exit 2. This fails safe and falls under decision 94's accepted 'failing-tests status is not 1' case. But the decision text names only runners (cargo's 101), not wrappers that rewrite the runner's status 1, so the docs could mention make as a common case that loses the re-run.

The `isRerunnable` JSDoc lists exit codes (130, pytest's 2, 129, 143) and the status-1 runners. All of that follows from `status === 1` and decision 94 already records it. The list will go stale as runner conventions change. Trimming the comment to the two WHYs (a Ctrl-C reaches the child; a timed-out re-run doubles the merge-lock hold) would leave the exit-code details in decision 94 alone.
